title: Health and Relative Humidity of Air
description: The optimum relative humidity ranges for bacteria, viruses, fungi, mites, asthma and other health conditions. Relative humidity (RH) should be within certain limits for control of the health aspect.

components.content:
## Guidelines

- **Bacteria**: 20 - 70% RH
- **Viruses**: 40 - 80% RH
- **Fungi**: 0 - 70% RH
- **Mites**: 0 - 60% RH
- **Respiratory Infections**: 40 - 50% RH
- **Allergic Rhinitis and Asthma**: 40 - 60% RH
- **Chemical Interactions**: 0 - 40% RH
- **Ozone Production**: 75 - 100% RH
- **Combined Health Conditions**: 40 - 60% RH

**General Comfort Range**: 30 - 60% RH is optimal for human comfort.
